# handlr-backend

> A lightweight, middleware-style ("pipe") PHP framework. The request path is
> DI container → router → per-request container scope → pipeline of pipes →
> handler. Object-level authorization (resolve → policy → bind) is a first-class
> layer, not a convention you remember to apply.

Composer package `phillipsharring/handlr-backend`, namespace `Handlr\`, PSR-4 root
`src/`, PHP >= 8.4. Deps: `psr/log`, `vlucas/phpdotenv`, `ramsey/uuid`,
`adbario/php-dot-notation`, `symfony/console|filesystem|process`; optional
`aws/aws-sdk-php` for SES. Tests use Pest.

The design bias is **explicit over magic**: constructor injection everywhere, no
static global state, abstractions you can read top to bottom. Two rules load-bear
and are worth internalizing before reading source:

- **Laziness.** Route pipes and the handler are `defer()`'d — resolved only when the
  chain reaches them. An auth / policy / CSRF short-circuit means downstream pipes
  and the handler are *never constructed*.
- **Scope binding is the injection mechanism.** `Router::dispatch()` opens a
  per-request `Container::scope()`. Any pipe can `$scope->singleton(Type::class, $x)`;
  because the child scope autowires *through* itself, a handler type-hinting `Type`
  receives that instance. This is how a resolved+authorized record reaches a handler.

## Principles

The values behind the design (full page: https://handlr.dev/principles):

- **Explicit, not magic.** Constructor injection, no static global state, readable top to bottom. Not a framework pretending to be Laravel.
- **Boring over clever.** Obvious code beats clever code. Write five plain lines instead of one cryptic one; optimize for the tired reader six months from now, not for keystrokes.
- **Instances over statics — statics are the rare exception.** Inject instances from the global or request-scoped container; avoid `SomeThing::doIt()`. It's consistent and, more importantly, trivially testable (swap a fake) where a static call is a hard-wired global.
- **One shape in, and it fails loud.** Methods take one argument shape and throw on the wrong one — no "string-or-object-or-array in case you forget," no guessing a swapped argument order. Defaults and genuine either/or inputs are fine; leniency that only papers over a caller's slip is not. (For AIs writing calls: get the types exact — that's the contract.)
- **Laziness is correctness.** Short-circuiting pipes mean the handler is never built — auth/policy denial is a structural property, not a convention.
- **Scope binding is injection.** A pipe binds by type into a request scope; the handler receives by type hint. No request bag, no string keys.
- **Authorization is structural.** Resolve → consult → bind; a forgotten ownership check is an IDOR bug, so the check is made unforgettable.
- **Split by cohesion.** Policy = one class per resource (its actions share context); invariant = one class per rule.
- **Results are values.** Handlers are HTTP-agnostic and reused for events; a listener is just a handler on an event name.
- **The framework owns mechanism, not your data.** Core provides seams (request identity, data-layer hooks, authz primitives); a feature that owns a table (undo, audit) is a module, not a dormant core migration.

## Writing Handlr code (rules — these also deprogram loose LLM defaults)

LLMs default to the magic-framework habits Handlr rejects. When generating code:

- **Records:** never declare real public properties for columns — use `@property` docblocks. Real props shadow the `__get`/`__set` magic and silently break `update()`/`toPersistableArray()`.
- **Types:** no `mixed`, no forgiving overloads. Pass the exact shape a signature asks for — a list-of-pairs is a *list* (`[['name','ASC']]`), not a single pair; don't pass a string expecting it to be parsed into an array.
- **Table conditions** are an assoc DSL keyed by column: equality `['status' => 'active']`, operator-first `['count' => ['>=', 10]]`, `['deleted_at' => null]` for IS NULL, `['id' => ['IN', [...]]]`. Not a raw SQL string, and not a swapped `[value, operator]`. Anything non-trivial goes in a `Query` class (write real SQL there).
- **No statics/globals:** inject dependencies through the constructor. Don't add facades, global helpers, or static method pools.
- **Routes** attach with `intoJunction('name')` to a junction declared in `app/routes.php`; declare the junction there first if it's missing.
- **Boring beats clever:** five clear lines over one cryptic one.

## Request lifecycle

- [Core/Kernel.php](src/Core/Kernel.php): boot singleton — registers services (Logger, Db, Session, Mailer, ResolutionRegistry + Resolver), adds global pipes (ErrorPipe, LogPipe), then boots providers → loads `app/routes.php` (declares junctions) → applies provider routes (fills them).
- [Core/Routes/Router.php](src/Core/Routes/Router.php): `dispatch()` matches the route, opens a request scope, `lay()`s global pipes, `defer()`s route pipes through the scope, injects a `ResolvePipe` before the handler when the route has a `Resolves` spec.
- [Core/Routes/Pipeline.php](src/Core/Routes/Pipeline.php): the onion. `lay(Pipe)` = built instance; `defer(fn(): Pipe)` = lazy link; `run()` folds them into a nested `$next` chain.
- [Pipes/Pipe.php](src/Pipes/Pipe.php): the contract — `handle(Request, Response, array $args, callable $next): Response`. Return `$next(...)` to continue or a `Response` to short-circuit.
- [Core/Request.php](src/Core/Request.php), [Core/Response.php](src/Core/Response.php): immutable HTTP value objects (`Response` has `HTTP_*` constants + `withJson/withHtml/withRedirect`).
- [Core/RequestException.php](src/Core/RequestException.php): base HTTP exception (message + status). `ErrorPipe` renders any subclass at its status — this is why `RecordNotFound` (404) / `PolicyDenied` (403) need no per-route wiring.

## Dependency injection

- [Core/Container/Container.php](src/Core/Container/Container.php): autowiring container. `bind/singleton/factory/alias/get/has`. `has()` is true only for *explicit* registrations (read-through to parent) — the key to scope delegation. Convention hooks: setter `inject(...)`, no-arg `init()`.
- `scope()`: request-lifetime child. Shared services resolve from the parent; anything bound locally (or built locally) resolves through the child, so scope-bound instances reach constructors. See `tests/Unit/Core/Container/ContainerScopeTest.php`.

## Routing & junctions

- [Core/Routes/RouteGroup.php](src/Core/Routes/RouteGroup.php): `group()`, `through()`, `get/post/patch/delete()`, `end()`. Params `{id}`, `{id:int}`, `{id:uuid}`, `{slug:slug}`, `{x:regex}`. A param may live in a group prefix (`->group('/{id:uuid}')`).
- **Junctions**: `->junction('api.authed')` labels a group as an extension point; a provider fills it with `$router->intoJunction('api.authed')->...`, inheriting its prefix + pipe stack. Declare the cross-cutting stacks (CORS/session/CSRF/auth) once in `app/routes.php`.
- **Resolve/policy binding**: `->resolves(RecordClass)->policy(Action)` per route, or on a *group before its first route* as an inherited default. See `tests/Unit/Core/Routes/RoutePolicyBindingTest.php`.

## Authorization (ADR 0004) — resolve → consult → bind

- [Resolution/Resolves.php](src/Resolution/Resolves.php): route metadata VO `(record, ?action, param='id')`.
- [Resolution/ResolutionRegistry.php](src/Resolution/ResolutionRegistry.php): `for(Record, Table, ?Policy)` map, populated in a provider `boot()`.
- [Resolution/Resolver.php](src/Resolution/Resolver.php) + [TableResolver.php](src/Resolution/TableResolver.php): `resolve(Table, id): Record` (findById-or-throw `RecordNotFound`). No auth, no state filtering.
- [Resolution/ResolvePipe.php](src/Resolution/ResolvePipe.php): the orchestrator — lookup binding → resolve record → if action set, `$policy->consult($actor, $action, $record)->orDeny()` → `$scope->singleton(RecordClass, $record)` for the handler.
- [Policies/Policy.php](src/Policies/Policy.php): `consult(AuthContext, PolicyAction, object): Decision`. One policy per resource type, action-dispatched. [PolicyAction.php](src/Policies/PolicyAction.php) is a marker for a per-domain enum. [Decision.php](src/Policies/Decision.php): `grant()/deny(?reason)/orDeny($status=403)`. `PolicyDenied` = 403.
- [Invariants/Invariant.php](src/Invariants/Invariant.php): `check(): ?Violation` — request-time preconditions (quotas, state), one class per rule. Distinct from domain invariants (which live in the aggregate).

## Data

- [Database/Table.php](src/Database/Table.php): table gateway, `@template T of Record`. `findById/findFirst/findWhere/paginate/count`, `insert/insertMany/update/delete`, and `hydrate(row)` (decodes BINARY(16) UUIDs — use it, not `new Record($row)`). Conditions DSL + `IN/BETWEEN/LIKE/NULL`, indexed `orderBy`.
- [Database/Record.php](src/Database/Record.php): active record. **`__get`/`__set` magic over `$data`** — never declare real public props for columns (they shadow the magic and break `update()`). `$uuidColumns`, `$casts`, `$computed`, UUIDv7 auto-id, `toPersistableArray()`.
- [Database/Db.php](src/Database/Db.php): PDO wrapper (`execute`, `uuidToBin/binToUuid`, transactions). [Query.php](src/Database/Query.php): base for custom SQL (`rows/row/scalar/count`).
- [Database/Migrations/](src/Database/Migrations/): `MigrationRunner`, `BaseMigration`, `Seeder`.

## Handlers, validation, responses

- [Handlers/Handler.php](src/Handlers/Handler.php): `handle(array|HandlerInput): ?HandlerResult` — HTTP-agnostic business logic, reused for HTTP *and* events. [HandlerResult.php](src/Handlers/HandlerResult.php): `ok($data,$meta)/fail($errors,$meta)`. [ValidatedInputFactory.php](src/Handlers/ValidatedInputFactory.php): the Pipe→Handler validation seam (route params + JSON body + server extras → validated typed input).
- [Validation/Validator.php](src/Validation/Validator.php): rule engine, `rule|arg1,arg2` syntax (pipe, not colon). Rules + sanitizers under `Validation/Rules` and `Validation/Sanitizers`; `ValidatesRules` trait for input classes; `OutputSanitizer` (static) for render-time escaping.
- [Api/Presenter.php](src/Api/Presenter.php): the JSON envelope. `withData/withSingleData/fromRecord/withMeta/only/without` then terminal `success/warning/validationError/invariantError`.

## Auth, sessions, CSRF

- [Auth/Pipes/](src/Auth/Pipes/): `StartSessionPipe`, `SessionAuthPipe` (session → `AuthContext`), `RequireAuthPipe` (401 JSON, never redirects), `RequirePermissionPipe` / `RequireAllPermissionsPipe` (coarse RBAC). Object-level auth is Policy, not these.
- [Csrf/](src/Csrf/): `CsrfService` (session token), `EnsureCsrfTokenPipe` (mirrors token to `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie + `X-CSRF-Token` header), `VerifyCsrfTokenPipe` (validates header, rotates after), `VerifyOriginPipe`, `CorsPipe` (same-origin).
- [Session/](src/Session/): `SessionInterface`, `Session`, `DatabaseSessionDriver` (DB-backed, wired by the Kernel).

## Providers, events, CLI

- [Core/ServiceProvider.php](src/Core/ServiceProvider.php): `register()` (bind only) → `boot()` (wire) → `routes(Router)` / `events(): array` / `migrationPaths()` / `seedPaths()` / `configDefaults()`. [ServiceProviderRegistry.php](src/Core/ServiceProviderRegistry.php) drives the lifecycle for both web + CLI.
- [Core/EventManager.php](src/Core/EventManager.php): `register(name, Handler)` + `dispatch(name, input)`. Listeners are ordinary Handlers returning `null`.
- [scripts/](scripts/): Symfony Console entrypoints — `make.php` (`make:*` scaffolders, see [Generator/](src/Generator/)), `migrate.php` (`up|down|rollback|fresh`), `seed.php`, `module.php`. **There is no global `handlr` bin.** The app skeleton exposes these as **composer scripts** in `backend/composer.json` that call the vendored scripts, so from a scaffolded app you run `composer run <name>` in `backend/`, e.g. `composer run migrate`, `composer run migrate:fresh`, `composer run seed`, `composer run make:record`, `composer run make:pipe`, `composer run make:scaffold`, `composer run module:install -- <name>`. See [handlr-app](../app/llms.txt) for the full command list.

## Other subsystems

- [Config/](src/Config/): dot-notation config over `.env` + a PHP config file.
- [Mail/](src/Mail/): `Mailer` + `MailMessage`, transports `log`/`smtp`/`ses`.
- [Log/](src/Log/): PSR-3 `Logger`.
- [Views/](src/Views/): server-side PHP templates (`ViewPipe` renders fragments for straight-HTMX apps).
- [Support/](src/Support/): `SortableList`, `TreeSortKeyService`, path helpers.
- [Generator/](src/Generator/): the maker framework behind `make:*`.
